business_summary.text: Aditya Birla Real Estate (formerly Century Textiles and Industries) develops premium residential and commercial real estate, mainly through Birla Estates in Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru and NCR, and has divested its Century Pulp and Paper business to ITC.

call_points.text: MMR region showed strong sustenance momentum with Birla Taranya contributing ₹123 Cr in booking value in Q2 FY27.
Announced a JDA for a 5.6-acre prime residential land parcel in Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune, having a GDV of ~ ₹1,650 crores.
Birla Taranya booked over ₹1,000 Cr within three months of RERA approval.
Gross debt remains from construction finance and long-term NCDs, which cannot be paid off.
Analysts pressed on lagging BD versus peers; management cited a risk-management framework and asked for patience, without naming a single blocker.
Cancellations at Birla Niyaara were rebooked at higher prices, at least ₹4 Cr more per apartment.
The BD pipeline is over ₹60,000 Cr, split across NCR, Mumbai, Pune and Bangalore.
The Noida Sector 150 land is completely out of the picture.
Management refrained from giving specific guidance for FY27 pre-sales due to uncertainties in approval timelines.
Construction spend for FY27 is expected to be around ₹1,200 crores.
Q4 pre-sales reached ₹4,288 crores, driven by strong new launches across MMR, NCR, Bengaluru, and Pune.
ITC transaction approvals from CCI received, with state-level approvals pending to conclude in the current quarter.
FY26 booking value reached ₹81,363 Mn supported by strong launches across MMR, NCR, Bengaluru, and Pune.

timeline.summary: Birla Estates reported a booking value of ₹8,136 crore for FY2026, driven by robust demand across NCR, Bengaluru, and MMR.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹82.61 Cr, net loss ₹110.31 Cr (against a loss of ₹135.2 Cr a year earlier).
Aditya Birla Real Estate released its Q4FY26 and FY26 earnings presentation, reporting annual booking value of ₹8,136 Cr and a Q4 net loss of ₹1,103 Mn.
Aditya Birla Real Estate reported Q4 FY26 pre-sales of ₹4,288 crore, bringing full-year pre-sales to ₹8,136 crore.
Birla Estates achieved ₹1,007 Cr sales booking at its Birla Taranya project in Thane within three months of receiving RERA approval.

On its Q1FY27 call on 14 August 2026, Aditya Birla Real Estate said collections rose 31% YoY to ₹713 Cr, net debt was virtually zero after receiving ₹3,325 Cr from ITC, and it maintained a ₹15,000 Cr pre-sales target over three years.
Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited schedules earnings conference call on October 26, 2026, at 5:00 PM (IST) to discuss Q2/H1 FY2026-27 results.
Aditya Birla Real Estate announced a new residential project in Hinjewadi, Pune via its subsidiary Birla Estates, with a revenue potential of ₹1,650 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹825.03 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹858.5 Cr (against a loss of ₹15.74 Cr a year earlier).
Aditya Birla Real Estate reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹825.03 Cr and net profit of ₹919 Cr, aided by the Century Pulp and Paper business divestment.
